description: Settings schema for the Gemini ACP extension. Runtime option lists must stay extension-owned; approval policy is the one harness-owned overlay because ACP permission prompts do not expose the footer/card hierarchy directly.

fields.label: Information
fields.description: Settings are derived from ACP initialize/availableCommands/SessionModeState payloads. Hardcoded option lists are intentionally absent so the UI never presents non-ACP data.

fields.label: Approval Policy
fields.description: Footer choices are Always approve, Ask, and Always reject. While Ask is active, Gemini approval cards offer Approve once, Approve all, and Reject; a sticky Ask-session grant appears as Ask ✅ until Ask is selected again.
